{{Quote|We visited Performance Square, a massive complex devoted to celebrating Lorrdian art and entertainment. |Tash Arranda|<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>}}
The '''Performance Square''' was a massive entertainment venue located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]. That 17-level, octogonal complex was devoted to Lorrdian theatrical arts. Each level included several theaters and performing areas, faced an open-air courtyard, and featured a facade representing a type of Lorrdian architecture. It took its name from an [[Performance Square (New Shallos)|ancient gathering place]] in [[New Shallos]] that had been destroyed by the [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdans]]. Although [[Actor/Legends|actors]] performed mainly in the theaters, those who had not booked often played in the many courtyards. The Performance Square was considered a good place to discover the next rising stars, which prompted many agents and talent scouts from [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]], [[Per Lupelo]], or even [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to attend the shows it hosted.
